body:
Hi, thanks for reaching out.
This is a behaviour we are aware of. It was indeed introduced in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4525/.
It's related to the fact we call twice in the render phase: once in [getRenderState](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/21b6c53d4b1a3f3dd3a2375a5cfe0a31bef6ded6/src/connectors/hits/connectHits.ts#L118) to compute the `hits` commited to the state, and another in [render](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/21b6c53d4b1a3f3dd3a2375a5cfe0a31bef6ded6/src/connectors/hits/connectHits.ts#L106). This brings some consistency in the way we handle the state in various connectors.

@algolia/instantsearch-for-websites I think a lot of users expect transformItems to apply only to the widget/connector they were defined on, so I'm wondering is we can make an exception on `transformItems` to have them computed only when executing `render`?
